## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit title (`fix:`, `feat:`, `ci:`, `docs:`, ...), see CONTRIBUTING.md
- [ ] Tests (including tenant-isolation tests where data is touched) or a manual verification note
- [ ] Documentation updated (affected README, `docs/`, an ADR for an architecture decision)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or personal data in code, tests or logs
